title: A high ideal multiple intersects a kernel in a prescribed kernel multiple
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], I a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], F a coherent module [pqf-def-coherent], H any module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and mu:F \to H a map whose kernel K is quasi-coherent. For each n>=0 there exists m>=0 such that I^m F \cap K \subset I^n K inside F. Products use recursive ideal powers and multiplication images [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk], and the containment holds on the section ranges over every open.

source.place: Tag 01YA, Artin-Rees inclusion used in Tag 01YB

proof.text: Coherence implies quasi-coherence and finite type; coherent_affine_sections_finite gives finite modules of sections on every affine open. Apply Ideal.exists_pow_inf_eq_pow_smul to the image of the kernel inclusion over each affine open, with Noetherian section ring.

Choose a finite affine subcover using compactness, and let c be Finset.sup of its module bounds. Set m=c+n. If k is the bound of a cover member, k<=c and Artin-Rees gives I^m F intersect K = I^(m-k)(I^k F intersect K). Rewrite m-k=n+(c-k), distribute multiplication of ideals over scalar multiplication, and use I^(c-k)(I^k F intersect K) contained in K. Submodule.map_smul and map_top express the resulting inclusion as an inclusion into the image of I^n K.

Apply affine_ideal_intersection_inclusion on each covering affine to obtain range inclusion on W intersect U. Restrict a section from the two global ranges by naturality. The product inclusion followed by the kernel inclusion is monic. Its local preimages agree on overlaps by injectivity and glue by the sheaf axiom, giving a preimage on W. Use Mathlib ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective for the evaluated monomorphism, then TopCat.Sheaf.existsUnique_gluing' and TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' directly for these local preimages. No duplicate range or injectivity helper is declared.

proof_origin.place: Finite affine cover proof of 01YA; algebraic bound and sheaf gluing proved in Lean; fixed-exponent affine inclusion comparison split off. The stated CoherentArtinRees import would close a source import cycle.

lean.statement:
theorem coherent_kernel_ideal_intersection_bound
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (I : X.IdealSheafData)
    (F H : X.Modules) (μ : F ⟶ H)
    (hF : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace F)
    (hK : (kernel μ).IsQuasicoherent) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, ∀ W : X.Opens,
      Set.range ((idealModuleProductι (idealSheafPower I.toModulesι m).2 F).app W) ∩
          Set.range ((kernel.ι μ).app W) ⊆
        Set.range ((idealModuleProductι (idealSheafPower I.toModulesι n).2
          (kernel μ) ≫ kernel.ι μ).app W)
